main_text.head: Errata.
main_text.p: PAg. 1. Omissum est aliquid, quod supplendum ita: Abacus in triclinio] Mensa vinaria, Varr. Mensa Delphica, Rhod. ex Porphyrio. Repositorium, Plin. Abacus calculatorius] Abacium, Mensa Pythagoræ &c. Minora ipsi lectores eruditi emendabunt. Ut quod pag. 417. Lorica, indusium ferrum, pro, ferreum, dicitur, & similia.

page.notes: The handwritten monogram in the lower centre is not printed text and is omitted. The first word "PAg." is printed with a large initial P, read as "PAg." Ligature of "Ut" as printed. "Lori-ca" hyphenated at line end, joined here.
